mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aup_review (aup_id, round_no, reviewer, role, verdict, comment) VALUES (#{aupId}, #{roundNo}, #{reviewer}, #{role}, #{verdict}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT id, aup_id AS aupId, round_no AS roundNo, reviewer, role, verdict, comment, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM aup_review WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND reviewer = #{reviewer} AND round_no = #{roundNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_review_assignment WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND round_no = #{roundNo}) AS assignCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_review_assignment WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND round_no = #{roundNo} AND status = 'recused') AS recusedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_review WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND round_no = #{roundNo} AND role = 'expert' AND verdict = 'agree') AS agreeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_review WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND round_no = #{roundNo} AND role = 'expert' AND verdict = 'disagree') AS disagreeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_review WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND round_no = #{roundNo} AND role = 'expert' AND verdict = 'modify') AS modifyCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_review WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND round_no = #{roundNo} AND role = 'expert' AND verdict = 'abstain') AS abstainCount
SELECT reviewer, role, verdict, comment FROM aup_review WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND round_no = #{roundNo} AND role = 'expert' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT f.field_key FROM form_field f LEFT JOIN form_section s ON f.section_id = s.id LEFT JOIN form_subsection sub ON f.subsection_id = sub.id LEFT JOIN form_section s2 ON sub.section_id = s2.id WHERE COALESCE(s.template_id, s2.template_id) = #{templateId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM form_field f LEFT JOIN form_section s ON f.section_id = s.id LEFT JOIN form_subsection sub ON f.subsection_id = sub.id LEFT JOIN form_section s2 ON sub.section_id = s2.id WHERE COALESCE(s.template_id, s2.template_id) = #{templateId}
mapper.sql: id, current_stage AS currentStage, round_no AS roundNo, review_form AS reviewForm, draft_source AS draftSource, template_id AS templateId, template_version AS templateVersion, pi_user_id AS piUserId, created_by AS createdBy, project_name AS projectName, register_no AS registerNo, is_demo AS isDemo
mapper.select: SELECT FROM aup_record WHERE id = #{aupId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE aup_record SET review_form = #{reviewForm} WHERE id = #{aupId}
mapper.sql: id, register_no AS registerNo, project_name AS projectName, pi_name AS piName, dept, current_stage AS currentStage, round_no AS roundNo, draft_source AS draftSource, submitted_at AS submittedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM aup_record WHERE current_stage = 'formatReview' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.register_no AS registerNo, r.project_name AS projectName, r.pi_name AS piName, r.dept, r.current_stage AS currentStage, r.round_no AS roundNo, r.draft_source AS draftSource, r.submitted_at AS submittedAt FROM aup_record r JOIN aup_review_assignment a ON a.aup_id = r.id AND a.round_no = r.round_no AND a.reviewer_id = #{reviewerId} AND a.status = 'pending' WHERE r.current_stage = 'expertReview' ORDER BY r.submitted_at DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT FROM aup_record WHERE current_stage = 'piReview' AND pi_user_id = #{piUserId} ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM aup_record WHERE current_stage = 'piReview' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
